estimand: intent_to_treat among users with at least one replay trigger
outcome_source: simulator outcome_events.jsonl, independently verified against goal rules
interpretation: The comparison follows randomized assignment, not action receipt. The denominator is all users in an assigned arm who had at least one replay trigger; users without a measurable eligible goal are counted as inconclusive and remain in the denominator. The approximate difference interval is a normal-approximation interval.
limitation: The supplied simulator is synthetic, only triggered users are simulated, and its outcome process does not apply every messaging-policy rule. This estimate is not evidence of real-world impact.
